{{Top}}
A '''telepath response unit''' was a component built into a [[B'omarr brain walker]] that was utilized by the [[Monk/Legends|monks]] of the [[B'omarr Order/Legends|B'omarr Order]]. The unit allowed the brain walker to react to the [[Telepathy/Legends|telepathic]] summons of the enlightened monks, which would then transport the monk's disembodied [[Brain/Legends|brain]] to its desired destination.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>

Like the rest of the walker's [[Spider/Legends|spider]]-like body, the unit was [[Color/Legends|colored]] black, and either sat atop the thorax on the six-legged model,<ref name="EGTD" /> or was housed in a protrusion atop the abdomen on the four-legged model.<ref name="VD">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>
